title: Maximum Sync Queue size Exceeded!  pop-up comes up frequently on the master
body:
There is one master and two followers.
The followers are xDrip Sync  followers.
The followers receive readings, no problem.

The master gets the pop-up "Maximum Sync Queue size Exceeded!" frequently.
It pops up any time an entry is made on the master.

I see this pop-up on line 755 of GcmActivity.java

@tzachi-dar I am sorry for tagging you.  I wonder if you can give me any hints as to what could trigger this if the followers are working fine, and if there is a way to stop the pop-ups.

I see this issue that has the pop-up in common:  https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/499

This is not an issue that I myself have experienced.  This is coming up on facebook.  I can get more detail from them if you guys tell me what you need.

comments.body: Important environment information like xDrip version is missing. Commit f4a1b6a fixed something with the queue. Maybe, a recent version does not have this issue.

I am waiting to get a response to my request for the revisions.
It is related that both seem to be caused by Google services.
However, this one is triggered somewhere else in the code, where enabling Desert Sync makes no difference.

This one is more annoying because there doesn't seem to be a way to stop the pop-ups on the screen.
Will open if I get more data.
First report on facebook that updating to February 11, 2021 has stopped the pop-ups.

I still get the pop ups :/ Libre 2 EU + bubble, nigtscout and master to a follower. Everything seems to be working as intended. I try to ignore the message but after months it's starting to bug me. Hope it'll be gone soon.

@Atterna What scheme are the followers on?
If you use Nightscout follower, and disable xDrip sync on the master, you will not get this pop-up anymore.
